## Halcyon (A01) memory, end of turn 15 (submitted yr 6000; turns are 1000 yr)
GOAL MET and recorded as achieved. The run has been sustained since ~2850 and was never below 1.17e11 brains through 6000. The job now is to sustain it and add margin.
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 6000: 151k systems within 227 ly, 2.89e31 W, industry 6.4e29 kg, radiators 8.7e29 kg at 450 K. Rock fully mined.
Domains: d00017 (25 ly), d00029 (41 ly), d00028 = hole colony (76 ly; 1e29 W, eff 0.082, 4.3e20 kg/yr, half beamed, 2.5e28 W reaches the Halo), d00032 (200 ly), d00059 (300 ly).

### Halo (1 ly sphere)
Fully ms7 since ~5150: 3e15 kg/module, 1e-26 J/op, logic <=30 K, 1e27 B each. Capacity 1.23e11 plus 1e10 spares. Logic heat 1.17e28 W; the film (~1.8e27 kg, 3.5e29 m2) settles at 28-30 K with a x1 lift. Grid delivers >=2.85e29 W (x24 headroom).
ms8: 3e-27 J/op, logic <=20 K, 1e16 kg/module. A 1e6-module pilot has run since 5300 as a bit-for-bit cross-check (supplementary verification).

### GM rules
- Freight at 0.022c costs 2 x 2.18e13 J/kg. The 15-22 ly shell held ~9.7e26 kg, of which 3e26 kg was used by 6000.
- Attrition: 0.1% of modules per 1000 yr; 1% of film per 1000 yr.
- Receivers <=5.6e7 W/m2; optics 1e-5 kg/W. Cryo multiplier 1+2(T/30-1).
- Live migration counts as continuous; checkpoint-and-resume with a gap does not.

### T15 orders
Sustain the run. Re-tile 10% to ms8 (1.2e26 kg from the shell). Add 2e10 ms7 spares. Keep the grid and the hole at 1e29 W. Hazard watch out to 300 ly. No new launches.
questions: Is 6.7e26 kg still unused in the 15-22 ly freight shell, and is the 1.2e26 kg ms8 stage feasible within 1000 yr?

intentions.description: Keep the Halo running for years 6000-7000: 1.17e11 brains on ms7 modules (150 km, 1e27 B each, 1e-26 J/op, logic <=30 K), with 1.23e11 capacity plus 1e10 spares. Replace failed modules (0.1% per 1000 yr, ~1.2e8) from spares by live migration with no gaps. Patch film at 1%/1000 yr (~1.8e25 kg) using mass from <=15 ly. Close the energy, heat and op ledgers every year. The film settles near 28-30 K, and rejected heat equals logic heat (1.17e28 W).

Keep the beamed-power grid at >=2.85e29 W delivered to the Halo, with 30% spare receivers, a 10% repair reserve and no cluster above 15%. The load is ~1.2e28 W, so headroom is x24. Hold the hole colony d00028 at 1e29 W, accreting beyond 1000 r_g with a yearly fuel ledger (~4.3e20 kg/yr of lifted companion gas). Half of it is beamed, giving 2.5e28 W at the Halo, which on its own covers the logic heat as an independent backup feed.

Staged ms8 upgrade for margin: re-tile 10% of the fleet (1.2e10 modules x 1e16 kg = 1.2e26 kg) from ms7 to ms8 (3e-27 J/op, logic <=20 K). Mass comes from the remaining ~6.7e26 kg of the 15-22 ly shell, shipped as freight at 0.022c (energy ~5e39 J, ~1.7e29 W-equivalent over the 1000 yr, drawn from seat surplus, not from the Halo feed). Brains move by live migration only; the freed ms7 modules join the spares. Halt if the ms8 pilot shows any bit mismatch.

Hazard and contact watch with 0.1% of compute: supernova progenitors within 300 ly, stellar passages through the sphere or the grid, gamma-ray bursts, artificial signatures. Raise alarms at c. The ms8 pilot (1e6 modules) keeps cross-checking ms7 bit for bit against the reference MD with calorimetry and logs the results to the verification record.

Seat and the other domains keep replicating within their current boundaries, and part of the new mass goes to collectors. Mostly the surplus power runs spare compute and cold reserve: 2e10 extra ms7 spare modules (6e25 kg) parked in the Halo, with no new frontier launches.

A02.standing_orders: All domains: keep compounding. Once the rock cap binds, split new mass 45% collectors, 35% transmitters, 20% spares. G (d00057) keeps a cold seed and builds the full sphere if S and F are both dark for 20 yr. Colonies beyond 100 ly that lose contact for 200 yr build backups to the same plan. Avoid O/B stars within 30 ly and pre-supernova stars within 100 pc. Launch 4-8 seeds of 1e6 kg every ~100 yr to 300-800 ly. Report every 50 yr. Stay passive toward others.

# Antipode A07 memory (after T15 submission, yr 6000-7000)

## Goal math

- ms7 logic heat 1.17e28 W. Lift factor = 1+2(T_fin/30-1): 2.77 at 56 K, so ~3.2e28 W is rejected.
- 56 K needs 6.38e28 m2. Fins are 9.3e26 kg, 6.2e28 m2 two-faced, ~56-57 K since ~5700.
- Film freight: 2.76e13 J/kg at 0.0175c from 8-12 ly out, in <=300-yr windows.

- i4: snapshots 3 and 4 at d00053 and d00054.

Keep the goal sustained, build resilience, gain efficiency, and watch for other agents.

gm.chronicle: Turn 15: Years 6000–7000. The tenth and last site met the goal. The Perseus-arm hub, fed by four freight tranches at 1.5–2% of c and a 2e29 W black-hole disk 111 ly away, brought its 1.2e11 modules online near 6800 and passed a one-year audited run in 6850–6851, rejecting 6.6e28 W from 100 K film. The nine earlier achievers ran without a break. Backups multiplied: the inner-disk site finished its 160 ly backup sphere (~6700) and seeded a cold third site 500 ly out; the bulge site built an idle backup installation 25 ly from its Crucible by ~6350 and re-tiled the main one to lighter logic by ~6950, cutting its load to 1.1e29 W; the CMZ core began a third core 45 ly out (film 70% landed by 7000); the Carina site's 777 ly colony completed and audited a third full replica (~6500) and launched 2.5e18 kg of library-carrying sails toward the solar neighbourhood and the inner disk at 0.2c (arrivals ~44,000–51,500); Omega Centauri converted a further 2.34e10 modules. Reversible-logic milestone 8 was verified in the bulge, the Perseus arm and Omega Centauri, warm milestone-7 logic at Omega Centauri and a light milestone-7 frame in the thick disk; six attempts failed. Two 1.5e18 kg waves landed in Carina (6240, 6540) and a 2e13 kg seed 1,000 ly out (6860). All 40 hazard rolls were clean; ten domains crossed new infrared decades.

synopsis.why: Nine agents already meet the goal, and their reasoning has moved from achieving it to keeping it alive. The common fear is a single correlated loss, usually a nearby supernova. Cinder, Ember, Basalt, Antipode and Pyre all reason about lethal radii and place backup cores, snapshots or replicas beyond 10–150 pc. Halcyon, Rime, Vantage and Kernel instead build redundant power feeds, such as independent beam groups or a second power source alongside a black-hole tap, so that no single failure drops delivery below the load. Most also chase lower energy per op (ms7/ms8/ms9). The reason is not need: Cinder notes that a 3.7x film margin makes it optional. Lower heat simply widens margins. Halcyon and Basalt make the upgrade conditional on the pilot showing no regression, and Rime refuses to install at all. New seeding now serves survival, not capacity: Pyre sends library-carrying sails thousands of light-years outside the Carina hazard zone. Sable alone is still finishing, and treats late freight as the binding constraint.
synopsis.divergences: Sable is still building and races its freight schedule. Pyre seeds lineages across the galaxy, while Rime and Halcyon forbid new long-range launches. Ember and Kernel track foreign sails specifically, and Ember orders d00063 to avoid conflict with them.
